detail.longDescription: https:// dev.to/sriram1983007/stop-your -ai-agent-from-signing-an-unlimited-usdc-approval-10c0 AI agents can now pay for APIs on their own with x402 and USDC, and a stablecoin payment is final. I wrote up three deterministic checks to run before an agent signs: hold token approvals (especially unlimited approve()), apply your own limits and new-payee rules, and check x402 / EIP-3009 signatures, including how long they stay valid.
